question: My TV has lines on the screen. I bought it in March. Is it still covered, and can you sort out a repair?
reference_answer: Your VisionMax 55" 4K TV (order VC-10001) was delivered on 12 March 2026. Lines on the screen are a panel defect, and panel defects are covered for 24 months from delivery, until 12 March 2028, so it is covered. Check the HDMI cable and try another port first. A repair ticket for VC-10001 has been drafted; it is only a draft that a person will review, not a submitted request.

question: How do I factory reset the XR-2200 router?
reference_answer: With the router switched on, press and hold the reset button for 10 seconds until the LED blinks amber, then release it. The router restarts, which takes about two minutes.
